definitions.explanation: Treating someone in a cold, dismissive, or unkind manner. Describes behavior toward others rather than personality in general.

examples.japanese: {邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{邪険|じゃけん}にして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not treat children unkindly.

examples.japanese: せっかく⟦{訪|たず}ねて→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧きた⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{返|かえ}す→追い返す：18691_oikaesu⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't just coldly turn away a guest who went out of their way to visit.

notes:
USAGE:
{邪険|じゃけん} almost always appears in the pattern {邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb, functioning adverbially. It describes cold or dismissive treatment of a person.
{邪険|じゃけん} focuses specifically on treatment of people, implying the speaker feels the harshness is unjustified or excessive. It is not used to describe objects or situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧ (to treat harshly)
- {邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be unkind to)
- {邪険|じゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}う→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧ (to coldly chase away)
